mode: timing: previous_motion; requires keyframe photometric + constant_velocity; rejects fixed_support
motion: SE3 body log from last two accepted depth roots, never current fit or labels
sample: target(pi(A*T*p)), source(pi(B*p)); geometric admission remains in depth frame
history: only accepted commits advance rate; reference rate frozen at its accepted endpoint; initial reference can be backfilled only from first accepted interval starting there
unavailable: nonzero offset without usable history, near-pi log or >0.1m/>0.15rad warp disables image constraints; exact zero offset is identity
rgb: fresh only, association within 20ms, phase difference gate replaced by both valid warps
evaluation: same 180 acquisitions per room/desk2; sensor ledger before label decoding; independent raw equations and provenance; synthetic images rendered at their own acquisition time
adoption: room accurate>64, desk2>=161; 179 accepted each, no expiry/reset, max translation and rotation <= original depth baseline in both records
